baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated perfect verbs عَبَسَ and تَوَلَّىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A contraction visible on the face is followed by active withdrawal. The sequence converts an inward pressure into a publicly legible closure and then into removal from relation.

activation_trace.role: Facial contraction from distress or anger supplies the visible closure that begins the mechanism.
Turning away and withdrawal carries the facial closure outward into a broken encounter.

changed_reading.before: Someone frowned and then departed.
changed_reading.after: A visible affective closure is immediately made relational: the face closes first, and access is removed second.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form تَوَلَّىٰ and the semantic tension inside root و ل ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root can organize adjacency, custodial responsibility, and directed attention as well as withdrawal. The surface action therefore carries the force of reversing an available relation of nearness, care, and facing.

activation_trace.role: Immediate nearness supplies the relation that the enacted withdrawal cancels.
Assuming charge supplies a latent duty of care against which withdrawal can register as relinquishment.
Turning face, hearing, or attention toward something supplies the positive orientation being reversed.
Withdrawal selects the negative pole of the root and makes the reversal actual.

changed_reading.before: The second verb reports a change of physical direction.
changed_reading.after: The second verb reverses the root's own possibilities of nearness, stewardship, and attentive facing; it is relinquished relation, not motion alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The frown joined to the priority and assignment branches of تَوَلَّىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A face does social work before speech: its contraction marks a negative valuation, while the following turn allocates attention elsewhere. The pair can therefore stage an act of ranking even before the object of the turn is disclosed.

activation_trace.role: The displeased face supplies a public signal of lowered valuation.
Priority and superior claim turn the change of orientation into a latent ranking decision.
Assigning good or harm supplies the idea that orientation itself confers a social value.

changed_reading.before: The verse records spontaneous annoyance.
changed_reading.after: The face and turn can function as a silent allocation of worth and of who receives the next share of attention.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal succession of the two verbs and the non-facial time branch of ع ب س.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first verb can cast the encounter itself as a harsh, constricted interval; the second follows it without relief. This makes the two-word sequence a miniature temporal environment rather than only a portrait of one face.

activation_trace.role: A harsh grim time enlarges the facial event into the quality of the whole encounter.
Unbroken succession makes withdrawal the immediate completion of that grim interval.
Actual withdrawal gives the compressed interval its terminating action.

changed_reading.before: The verse captures a fleeting facial reaction.
changed_reading.after: The reaction briefly makes the encounter itself grim, with withdrawal arriving as its uninterrupted second phase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arriving person lacks sight, while the focus actions close a face and remove face, hearing, or attention. The turn now functions as an access gate: a person already limited in one sensory channel meets a second, socially imposed closure.

activation_trace.role: Facial contraction makes the first barrier publicly perceptible.
The branch explicitly includes directing face, hearing, or attention and thus identifies the channel being withheld.
Withdrawal closes that channel after the visible frown.
Actual arrival places the other person at the threshold of encounter rather than at a distance.
Loss of sight makes responsive voice, face, and attention materially consequential modes of access.

structural_cues: The causal clause in 80:2 attaches both focus verbs to this particular arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, physical blindness, facial contraction, attentive facing, and withdrawal; I infer that withdrawal compounds an existing access constraint. A live alternative is that blindness only identifies the visitor and the turn has no sensory-access function.

changed_reading.before: A frown is followed by a generic turn away.
changed_reading.after: The two actions form an access barrier at the exact moment an arriving person depends on responsive attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attention is allocated toward the self-sufficient person and away from the purposeful, reverent seeker whose growth remains possible. The priority branch of و ل ي turns the focus action into an inversion of claims: apparent independence attracts care while active receptivity loses it.

activation_trace.role: Priority and superior entitlement supply the ranking axis on which the two recipients are ordered.
Taking charge makes attention a custodial resource rather than a neutral glance.
Growth supplies the concealed future value that surface status fails to register.
Self-sufficiency marks the person toward whom attention is nevertheless concentrated.
Deliberately addressing oneself toward something supplies the positive attention given to the self-sufficient party.
Purposeful movement toward a desired end establishes the ignored person's active claim.
Reverent fear adds inward receptivity to the seeker's outward effort.
Being occupied away from one thing by another identifies attention diversion as the operative failure.

structural_cues: The parallel أما...فأنت clauses in 80:5-10 contrast whom the addressee faces with whom he neglects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-sufficiency, deliberate facing, purposeful seeking, reverent fear, possible growth, and distraction; I infer that the focus turn ranks social appearance over receptive potential. The alternative is a tactical allocation of limited time rather than a judgment of worth.

changed_reading.before: The turn is an isolated lapse of courtesy.
changed_reading.after: The turn is a priority inversion that directs custodial attention toward independence and away from a live growth trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical sight and actual discernment separate. The focus subject can orient his body while lacking knowledge of the visitor's possible growth and recollection; the person labeled blind may carry the more accurate inner direction.

activation_trace.role: The face displays a settled negative judgment before the hidden outcome is known.
Directed face, eye, hearing, and attention make bodily orientation the counterpoint to epistemic orientation.
Blindness of heart or insight permits the label of blindness to rebound from the visitor toward the act of judgment.
Knowledge names precisely what the rhetorical question withholds from the judging subject.
The split-root image of road bearing and alignment turns not-knowing into a problem of taking the wrong direction.
Possible growth is the unseen outcome that makes premature certainty fail.
Recovery into awareness supplies the visitor's possible inward direction despite outward blindness.

structural_cues: The interrogative and لعل in 80:3 suspend certainty about what the visitor may become.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical blindness, an inward-blindness branch, withheld knowledge, road alignment, and possible growth; I infer an ironic transfer of blindness to the sighted evaluator. The materially live alternative keeps عمي solely physical and reads the correction as uncertainty without irony.

changed_reading.before: The sighted subject sees an interruption and turns away from a blind visitor.
changed_reading.after: The bodily turn exposes an epistemic misdirection: the sighted evaluator cannot yet see the visitor's latent trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The visitor is moving intentionally toward an end, while the focus turn diverts the encounter away from that motion. The split س ع ي inventory keeps purposeful striving and aimless neglect together, allowing the two participants to occupy opposite trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Attaining a goal supplies the unrealized endpoint toward which the visitor's motion can be read.
Withdrawal bends the encounter away from the approaching trajectory.
Purposeful motion toward a desired object gives the ignored approach direction and intent.
The non-dominant split-root image of neglectful, directionless going supplies a counter-trajectory for the one who turns away.
An extended traversable path enlarges the visitor's local approach into a human route.
Opening and ease after difficulty establish facilitation as the contextual counterforce to obstruction.

structural_cues: The repeated motion language of 80:8 and 80:20 places the local approach inside a larger path motif.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful striving, a split image of aimless going, a traversable path, ease, goal attainment, and withdrawal; I assign the purposeful trajectory to the visitor and the counter-trajectory to the turning subject. Another reading may leave the split non-dominant branch inactive.

changed_reading.before: The subject turns away from a person.
changed_reading.after: The subject turns across a purposeful trajectory and momentarily obstructs a path whose larger contextual movement is toward ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is represented as a transmitted object: written, carried by hands, disclosed by envoys, and made effective in truthful action. The focus turn interrupts this chain at its human reception point, making withdrawal a relay failure rather than merely a private reaction.

activation_trace.role: Continuous succession supplies the relay form in which one carrier follows another.
Taking charge supplies the local custodial role that the turn abandons.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the content meant to reach a receptive person.
The written sheet gives the reminder a transmissible material station.
Handing something onward supplies the transfer operation between stations.
The split-root image of supported power keeps the relay enabled rather than merely manual.
A book that discloses its writing joins carrier and unveiling in one branch image.
Truth carried through word and deed supplies the relay's intended completion in action.

structural_cues: Verses 80:11-16 move from reminder to sheets to hands to carriers in a tightly linked nominal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, sheets, hands, supported power, disclosing carriers, truthful enactment, succession, and custody; I infer that responsive human attention is the last station of the same relay. The alternative treats the elevated transmission scene only as praise of the reminder's source.

changed_reading.before: The turn rejects one interruption.
changed_reading.after: The turn temporarily breaks a carefully staged transmission chain precisely where the reminder should become reception and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root of the focus turn contains assuming charge, while its enacted branch is withdrawal. The later language of completing and discharging what is commanded converts this inner opposition into an office model: an entrusted task is left unfinished at the point of encounter.

activation_trace.role: Assuming charge supplies the entrusted office latent in the focus root.
Withdrawal enacts the opposite of remaining with the entrusted matter.
Completion and finishing supply the criterion by which the local turn can be seen as unfinished work.
Discharging a due right frames completion as obligation owed, not optional polish.
Binding request or command supplies the mandate whose execution remains incomplete.

structural_cues: The negated completion clause in 80:23 comes after the reminder scene and before the imperative to look.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies charge, withdrawal, completion, discharge of a right, and command; I connect the focus encounter to the later general mandate as a local instance of unfinished entrusted work. A live alternative restricts 80:23 to humanity in general without retroactive reference to the opening actor.

changed_reading.before: The turn is a momentary social mistake.
changed_reading.after: The turn is the negative image of taking charge: an entrusted communicative task is relinquished before its claimant's right is discharged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder is available to whoever wills to remember, but the focus expression and turn silently decide in advance who merits continued access. The handler's allocation of attention thus preempts the recipient agency stated by the reminder itself.

activation_trace.role: Priority supplies the unspoken decision about whose response is treated as worth pursuing.
Assignment supplies the act of distributing access or withholding it.
The reminder is the available object whose reception should remain open.
Actual recollection locates the decisive uptake in the recipient rather than the distributor.
Volition attached to the thing supplies the listener's own agency to take up the reminder.

structural_cues: The general من شاء in 80:12 follows the rebuke of selective attention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies priority, assignment, reminder, recollection, and recipient volition; I infer that turning away acts as premature gatekeeping. The alternative reads whoever wills as theological scope without any procedural claim about the opening encounter.

changed_reading.before: The turn expresses the speaker's own preference.
changed_reading.after: The turn lets the handler's preference preempt the listener's stated freedom to receive and remember.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening contrast behaves like a sieve that selects by visible independence and excludes hidden receptivity. Later branches of measuring creation, measured planning, and choosing the best expose the filter as miscalibrated because growth cannot be inferred from surface rank.

activation_trace.role: The face supplies the first visible reject signal of the sorting operation.
Priority makes the turn an allocation based on the filter's ranking.
Potential growth is the hidden value that the surface filter misses.
Measuring and proportioning creation supplies a deeper scale than social appearance.
Deliberate measured planning supplies the alternative to snap valuation.
Selecting the best activates the sieve image and reveals that the opening encounter performs a selection of people.

structural_cues: The wealthy and the striving visitor are contrasted before the text moves through common human origin and cultivated growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden growth, creation by measure, measured planning, and a branch of selecting the best; I infer a social filtering mechanism behind the frown and turn. The alternative keeps the palm-root branch local and describes the opening only as distraction.

changed_reading.before: The subject chooses the more promising audience member.
changed_reading.after: The subject uses a faulty social sieve: visible self-sufficiency passes while the person with actual growth potential is screened out.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dry or covering surface need not disclose what can grow beneath it. The agricultural sequence activates the frown as an act that fixes another person at the visible surface, while the ignored possibility of purification behaves like a covered seed awaiting opening.

activation_trace.role: Dry clinging residue supplies a material image of a surface treated as fixed and unattractive.
Withdrawal prevents continued contact with whatever latent change the surface may conceal.
Growth names the visitor's explicitly possible but not yet visible outcome.
Covering seed supplies the hidden-potential state beneath an unpromising exterior.
Splitting and opening supply the necessary breach through the enclosing surface.
Plant emergence makes latent life visible after the opening.
The grain that germinates supplies the compact carrier of overlooked potential.

structural_cues: The possible growth of 80:3 precedes the later water, split earth, emergence, and grain sequence of 80:25-27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dry residue, possible growth, covered seed, opened earth, emerging plant, and grain; I map the agricultural sequence onto the social perception of the visitor. The alternative rejects the material analogy and keeps purification non-ecological.

changed_reading.before: The frown reacts to an immediately visible interruption.
changed_reading.after: The frown mistakes a surface condition for the whole person and turns away from seed-like potential before it can open and grow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same arrival root marks the blind visitor, the striving visitor, and the overwhelming event. At first the focus subject controls the encounter by turning away from one who comes; at the final arrival, control reverses and people themselves flee, each absorbed by a concern that suffices him.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary withdrawal supplies the initial claim to control who can be avoided.
The first human arrival is the one from which the focus subject withdraws.
Repeated human arrival establishes approach as a deliberate recurring pressure on attention.
The final arrival scales approach from avoidable visitor to unavoidable event.
Sufficiency turns each person's own concern into the total occupation that displaces every relation.
Flight reverses the opening geometry: the people who once turned from arrivals now cannot escape arrival except by fleeing one another.

structural_cues: جاء recurs at 80:2, 80:8, and 80:33, with the final occurrence immediately followed by flight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three arrivals, voluntary withdrawal, final flight, and self-sufficient preoccupation; I infer an escalation that reverses the subject's control over approach. The alternative treats the repeated verb as ordinary recurrence without a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The subject can end an unwanted encounter by turning away.
changed_reading.after: The opening turn is the small, voluntary form of a geometry later reversed: an unavoidable arrival makes every person flee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root holds nearness, support, and kinship patronage, yet the action selects withdrawal. The final flight from brother, mother, father, companion, and children expands this local relinquishment into the collapse of every normally protective near relation.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and support supply the help that proximity would ordinarily make available.
Kinship, neighborhood, and patronage supply a network of protective claims reversed by the turn.
Flight makes relational withdrawal explicit and universal.
Brotherhood supplies the lateral bond from which flight occurs.
Motherhood and nurture supply the originating care relation that no longer holds.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply another protective relation overtaken by flight.
Companionship and sustained proximity supply the intimate bond that withdrawal breaks.
Filial descent supplies the dependent relation from which the parent also flees.

structural_cues: Verses 80:34-36 enumerate relations from sibling and parents to spouse and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support and patronage within و ل ي, explicit flight, and a sequence of near relations; I infer that the opening withdrawal is a local rehearsal of relational relinquishment. The alternative reserves the final flight for a categorically different event with no backward pressure on 80:1.

changed_reading.before: The subject briefly disengages from one stranger.
changed_reading.after: The turn activates the failure of nearness itself, a small relinquishment later amplified across every protective bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-facial branch of ع ب س names a harsh grim time, and the ending explicitly distributes opposed states across faces on the severe day. The opening face becomes a proleptic sample of that temporal atmosphere, set against faces that later open in laughter or are overlaid by dust and constriction.

activation_trace.role: The harsh grim day branch lets the opening expression project from face onto time.
Literal facial contraction keeps the projection anchored in the visible opening action.
A day's severe event activates the temporal scale already latent in the focus root.
The face as visible frontage makes the ending answer the face that opened the surah.
Expansion of the face and exposure of the teeth supplies the open counter-state to frowning contraction.
Dust and earth-color supply the material overlay on the opposed final faces.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the direction by which the dark state covers the face.
Facial gloom supplies the final concentrated analogue of the opening frown.

structural_cues: The surah opens with one face event and closes by contrasting two populations of faces on that day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grim-time branch for the focus root, a severe day, and opposed facial states; I infer deliberate prolepsis from the first face into the final day. The alternative reads the opening face and ending faces as thematic repetition without temporal projection.

changed_reading.before: The frown belongs only to the opening actor and moment.
changed_reading.after: The frown is also a compressed forecast of a grim temporal atmosphere whose final effects become visible across many faces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus closes the face and then removes frontal encounter. The context repeatedly counters that motion through unveiling, opening, spreading, splitting, exposed surfaces, and final faces; withdrawal becomes an anti-disclosure gesture inside a surah whose material and textual processes force hidden things outward.

activation_trace.role: Facial contraction supplies the first local closure.
Facing with eye, ear, or attention supplies the frontal relation that could disclose the other.
Withdrawal removes that frontal relation and completes the closure.
Removing a cover supplies the textual counter-motion of disclosure.
Covering supplies the recurrent opposite pole against which disclosure works.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply expansion after enclosure.
Splitting the earth supplies a forceful material disclosure of what is beneath.
Face-to-face encounter supplies the relational disclosure refused in the focus.
The appearing skin surface makes inner condition publicly legible.
Wide rupture and eruption provide the sequence's strongest final image of forced opening.

structural_cues: The context moves through disclosed sheets, opened creation, split earth, emergent food, and finally exposed faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facial closure, withdrawal from facing, covering, unveiling, spreading, splitting, visible surfaces, and eruption; I infer a sustained closure-versus-disclosure mechanism. The alternative treats these as independent domain images rather than a backward activation of the opening gestures.

changed_reading.before: The two verbs close one brief social encounter.
changed_reading.after: The two verbs form an anti-disclosure movement that the rest of the surah repeatedly reverses by bringing hidden potential and final condition to the surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch allows distress as well as anger, and a late branch depicts a person overwhelmed by many visitors and questioners. This keeps an overload hypothesis alive beside the stronger status-priority reading: the frown may register pressure before the turn becomes a culpable allocation of that pressure.

activation_trace.role: Distress or anger leaves the affective cause underdetermined rather than fixing contempt.
Withdrawal remains the consequential response even if the initiating affect is overload.
Arrival supplies the immediate new demand entering the scene.
Being crowded by visitors and questioners supplies a concrete social-overload model for the opening distress.

structural_cues: The opening section contains an arrival, competing addressees, questions, and redirected attention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a distress-or-anger frown, an arriving demand, withdrawal, and a branch of visitor overload; I assign overload as one possible cause, not as exculpation. The competing status-bias reading remains stronger because attention is explicitly distributed asymmetrically.

changed_reading.before: The frown transparently expresses contempt for the visitor.
changed_reading.after: The frown may first register overload, while the subsequent choice of whom to face still turns that pressure into a biased withdrawal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates camel-grime and seasonal-rain branches far from the verbs' syntax. It remains valid as a packet-backed material counter-image: dry adhesion in the first root, after-rain in the second, then poured water, opened earth, and growth in context. Downstream prose must present it only as a latent material sequence, never as a claim that تَوَلَّىٰ denotes rain here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exact order of عَبَسَ then تَوَلَّىٰ and their dry-residue and after-rain branches.

activation_trace.role: Dried clinging grime supplies the initial hardened material state.
Rain following an earlier rain supplies a reparative successor state within the second root.
Conveying water by irrigation or pouring activates the rain image as an effective material input.
Opening the hardened ground supplies the transition from wetting to release.
Emergent vegetation supplies the changed state made possible after water and opening.

changed_reading.before: The two actions move only from displeasure to abandonment.
changed_reading.after: At a distant material register, the ordered roots also hold hardened accretion followed by after-rain, allowing the later water-and-growth sequence to carry a reparative countercurrent beneath the rebuke.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the pupil branch of the garden root answer the blind visitor across many verses. It remains anchored through the focus root's eye-attention branch and the context's explicit blindness, looking, and garden word. Downstream prose should call it an ocular-ecological echo, not identify the garden lexeme with an eye in this construction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ as withdrawal of face, eye, hearing, or attention after a frown.

activation_trace.role: The visible face supplies the sighted agent's bodily interface.
Turning eye and attention toward something identifies the visual faculty whose direction is at issue.
Physical loss of sight places vision explicitly inside the opening encounter.
Directing sight or insight toward a thing converts seeing into disciplined attention.
The pupil branch hidden in the garden root returns the image of the eye inside the growth scene.

changed_reading.before: Blindness belongs to the visitor, while the sighted subject merely chooses another direction.
changed_reading.after: The garden's latent pupil and the command to look let visual competence rebound onto the sighted subject: possessing eyes does not guarantee attentive seeing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats a human face as a page-like surface and activates the misreading branch of صحف. It remains anchored in the literal frown, written sheets, disclosing book, visible surface, and final faces. Downstream prose must mark the page-face equivalence as a reader-supplied analogy and must not lexicalize the face as صحيفة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَبَسَ as a visible facial sign that is immediately acted upon by turning away.

activation_trace.role: The contracted face supplies a visible sign and also reveals the evaluator's reading response.
Misreading or corrupt reading supplies the possibility that the human sign has been wrongly decoded.
A book that reveals writing supplies the model of a surface whose marks require accurate disclosure.
The right face or aspect of a matter supplies the interpretive question of what a visible face actually means.
Appearing skin and surface keep the analogy tied to visible human exterior.

changed_reading.before: The opening face expresses annoyance at a person whose value is already known.
changed_reading.after: The opening becomes a scene of misreading: a visible human surface is decoded too quickly, and the mistaken reading is enacted as withdrawal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts the focus from face and sight to hearing and returned sound. It remains valid because the focus branch explicitly includes directing hearing, while blindness, echo, spoken remembrance, and mediation are packet-backed cues. Downstream prose should present an access-channel hypothesis, not claim that the verse names an echoing conversation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ as possible withdrawal of hearing or attention as well as face.

activation_trace.role: Directed hearing and attention supply the sensory channel that the turn can withhold.
Physical blindness raises the relative importance of speech and auditory response.
Returned echo supplies a model of sound that receives an answer rather than falling into silence.
Mention carried on the tongue supplies the voiced content that seeks a responsive channel.
A mediator who removes estrangement supplies the social function of answering distance with connection.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is chiefly a visual gesture.
changed_reading.after: For a visitor without sight, the turn can also close an auditory reciprocity loop: voiced seeking receives no human return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the pastoral branch of separating young livestock from mothers inside a human social scene. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and is reactivated by livestock, mother, children, and flight later in the packet. Downstream prose must call it a pastoral analogy for dependent-bond severance, not the lexical sense of تَوَلَّىٰ in 80:1.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus turn as a withdrawal whose root inventory includes separation of young from older animals or mothers.

activation_trace.role: Separating young livestock from elders or mothers supplies the dependent-bond severance image.
Livestock explicitly reactivates the pastoral domain in the context.
Flight supplies the later human severing motion.
Motherhood and nurture identify the bond named in the pastoral branch.
Filial descent supplies the human dependent relation later abandoned in flight.

changed_reading.before: The turn ends contact with one petitioner.
changed_reading.after: At a distant pastoral register, the turn is an early severing of a dependent bond that the ending enlarges into flight from mother and children.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a date-ripening branch of the exact form تولى and connects it to facial color and residue. It remains packet-grounded through palms, visible faces, and dust-color at the ending. Downstream prose must keep the ordinary withdrawal syntax primary and describe this only as a secondary surface-state resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ together with the dry-surface branch of عَبَسَ.

activation_trace.role: Dried adhered matter supplies a changed and visibly coated surface.
Dates beginning to dry or change color supply a processual surface transition inside the exact focus root.
The palm tree reactivates the date domain in the agricultural list.
Visible faces supply the human surfaces whose states are finally contrasted.
Dust and earth-color supply the explicit final alteration of facial surface.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an expression and a movement.
changed_reading.after: A secondary material reading sees both verbs as surface transitions, anticipating the later palms and faces whose color and coating visibly change.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it legalizes an intimate encounter through branches of entitlement, document of right, and discharge. It remains anchored in the focus root's priority and assignment branches and in packet-backed reminder and completion branches. Downstream prose should call the visitor claim-bearing by analogy, not assert a formal legal proceeding.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ as a turn that allocates priority and can assign benefit or harm.

activation_trace.role: Superior claim and entitlement supply the question of whose request deserves priority.
Assigning benefit or harm turns attention into something conferred upon a recipient.
A written memorial of right supplies the legal image of a claim that should remain legible.
Discharging and satisfying a due right supplies the obligation to answer the claim.
Binding direction supplies the authority behind fulfillment rather than discretionary favor.

changed_reading.before: The visitor requests attention that may be granted or declined.
changed_reading.after: The visitor can be carried as a claim-bearing petitioner whose priority is misjudged and whose due share of the reminder is left undischarged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the two-faced branch from the final face root to describe an earlier allocation of attention. It remains anchored in the focus opposition between facing and withdrawing and in the explicit contrast between self-sufficient and striving recipients. Downstream prose must describe a split social frontage, not accuse the actor of the settled moral type called two-faced.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The latent facing branch and actual withdrawal branch of تَوَلَّىٰ after the frown.

activation_trace.role: Turning toward with face or attention supplies one frontage of the allocation.
Withdrawal supplies the opposed frontage shown to the other recipient.
Self-sufficiency identifies the recipient toward whom the attentive frontage is directed.
Purposeful seeking identifies the recipient who receives withdrawal instead.
The two-faced branch supplies a compact image for incompatible social frontages allocated by status.

changed_reading.before: The focus shows one face closing and one body turning.
changed_reading.after: The later contrast reveals a split frontage already latent at the opening: an attentive face for apparent independence and a withdrawn face for purposeful need.

strongest_changes: The second verb changes from motion into a reversal of nearness, stewardship, attentive facing, and priority.
The blind visitor's arrival turns the frown-and-turn sequence into an access gate and an epistemic misdirection under uncertainty.
The contrast between self-sufficiency and purposeful receptive striving reveals a misallocated economy of attention.
The reminder, sheets, hands, and carriers recast the turn as a break in transmission and an unfinished entrusted mandate.
Repeated arrival, final flight, and opposed faces enlarge the local gesture into a reversed geometry of control and a forecast of the grim day.
summary.what_was_special: The packet did not force one motive or one scale. It kept contempt, overload, access, custody, ranking, misreading, growth, relay, kinship, and material surface-change readings alive together. Especially generative were split-root directions, the opposition inside و ل ي between care and withdrawal, and late branches that made the opening face answer to seeds, pages, eyes, rain, kin, and final faces.
remaining_uncertainties: The status-priority mechanism is stronger than the overload hypothesis, but the distress-or-anger branch does not eliminate overload as an initiating affect.
The epistemic transfer of inward blindness to the sighted evaluator is abductively strong but not grammatically assigned by the packet.
The relay and mandate models depend on treating responsive attention as the final station of the later transmission sequence.
Agricultural, pastoral, page-face, rain, date-color, and two-faced readings are branch-backed analogies and should remain explicitly exploratory rather than lexical substitutions.
